page.content:
Maranello constructor — the only team present since 1950.

How Scuderia Ferrari connects

  • Character: Enzo Ferrari — Enzo Ferrari founded the Scuderia that still races in Formula 1.
  • Character: Michael Schumacher — Michael Schumacher won five straight titles with Ferrari.
  • Topic: Formula 1 — Ferrari is the only constructor present since the first World Championship.
  • Event: Italian Grand Prix — Ferrari's home grand prix is the Italian Grand Prix at Monza.
  • Item: World Constructors' Championship — Ferrari has treated the Constructors' Championship as a birthright prize.
  • Creator: Niki Lauda — Niki Lauda won Drivers' Championships with Ferrari before his McLaren years.

What is Scuderia Ferrari?

Scuderia Ferrari is Formula 1's oldest surviving team: Enzo's scarlet cars, Schumacher's early-2000s titles, and the constructors' prize the tifosi still treat as a birthright.

Key threads lead to Enzo Ferrari, Michael Schumacher, Formula 1, Italian Grand Prix, World Constructors' Championship and Niki Lauda.
